name: Aabir Indexing Api
author: aabirwave

sections.description:
The Aabir Indexing api plugin sends a crawl request to Google using the Google Indexing API. JobPosting or BroadcastEvent, VideoObject pages are quickly indexed in Google.

External 3rd party services

This plugin connects to an API to obtain weather information, it’s needed to show the weather information and forecasts in the included widget.

It sends the user’s location every time the widget is loaded (If the location isn’t available and/or the user hasn’t given their consent, it displays a configurable default location).
This service is provided by “PRT Weather INC”: terms of use, privacy policy

External links

Google urlNotifications show for publish – https://indexing.googleapis.com/v3/urlNotifications:publish
Google addScope for indexing URL – https://www.googleapis.com/auth/indexing

There are a lot of points of having your content instantly crawled and indexed by the search engines:

  • Keep search results up-to-date
  • One-time Setup
  • Manual Submissions
  • Send request Post
  • Compatible with the Plugin
  • Completely FREE.
sections.installation:
1. Visit ‘Plugins > Add New’
  2. Search for ‘Aabir Indexing Api’
  3. Install Aabir Indexing Api
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to “after activation” section below.

Manually

  1. Upload the instant-indexing-api folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the Aabir Indexing plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to “after activation” section below.

After activation

  1. You should see the settings.
  2. From there you can access the plugin settings.
  3. You’re done!
sections.faq:
Please email aabirwave@gmail.com with any questions.

Q: Can I use the plugin.

A: Yes, you absolutely can. You can use the Aabir Indexing plugin.

Uninstall plugin?

Uninstall process removes all process of indexing once you remove the plugin via the WordPress Plugins (not on deactivation).
